## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.20

This release adds the first Organizer queue workflow.

### Added

- Organizer **Queue** panel for freezing the current setup as a queued remux job.
- **Add current**, **Run queue**, **Remove selected**, and **Clear finished** controls.
- Sequential queue execution using the existing Organizer remux worker.

### Notes

- Queue entries are snapshots of the current Organizer inputs/settings/manual selections at the time they are added.
- Jobs run one at a time to avoid parallel MKVToolNix/remux load. You can still keep preparing later Organizer jobs while the current queue item runs.
